title: Nibû
description:
(Preview video above is outdated, a new one will follow up soon)
Nibû is a real-time strategy game set in the ancient near east.
Choose between 3 different allied factions, build your base and defeat the hordes of enemies. Be challenged by 3 different scenarios.

War has brought ruin upon the world of the Ashur Union. The allied "Horde" has destroyed a large part of their standing army and is winning decisively.
The few battles that decide their fate are in your hands!Features
• RTS Style unit control and construction

• Wave Based Endless Survival Mode

• Custimize your games with wave strength, frequency, and intelligence

• Fight enemies on an epic scale with hordes of enemies attacking your base

• Unique nemesis' that challenge specific skills and management

• Fortify your base and lay out traps

• Full control over your economy, assign units to farms, agriculture, forests and mines

• Build large cities, sustain your economy

• Recruit large armies to dominate your foes

• Protect your Capitol

• Defend yourself from armies and hordes that grow continuously stronger and require more tactical maneuvers to beat

• New Skirmish mode: Fight one of the 5 iconic enemies in a Skirmish

• New Enemy Units: Over 17 different faction-specific units with unique strengths and weaknesses.

• Hostile Camps: Destroy battle encampments to gain gold and weapons.
description_short: Nibû is a real-time strategy game set in an alternate history ancient near east. Build, expand and fortify yourself in different scenarios to fight the oncoming armies of the allied hordes.
